name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2513: capture_beat called live_panel_gate._fetch, whose defaults are 15s across 3 tries. Those are correct for a gate, where a missed beat is a false alarm, but observed() calls capture_beat on every observation and for the ledger a missed beat is UNKNOWN which is already reported honestly. Measured against a socket that accepts and never answers: 45.0s before, 2.0s after. A console that is simply down refuses instantly and was never the problem - it is the hung one that stalls. The gate budget is untouched and the guard asserts both halves.
